profile.name: Robotell CAN总线接口
profile.description: 用于连接和配置 Robotell CAN 总线接口设备的通信接口，可设置 CAN 比特率、串口速率、自动重传和硬件过滤，并发送 CAN 帧。适合在实验系统中与使用 CAN 总线通信的控制器、传感器或执行机构进行数据交换。
profile.description_en: A communication interface for connecting to and configuring a Robotell CAN bus interface device. It supports setting CAN bitrate, serial port rate, automatic retransmission, and hardware filters, and can transmit CAN frames. It is suitable for laboratory systems that need to exchange data with CAN-based controllers, sensors, or actuators.
